senses.gloss: f. (מָחָה) protest to prevent the claim of undisturbed possession (v. חֲזָקָה).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 38a:6">B. Bath. 38ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מ׳ שלא בפניו הויא מ׳</he> a protest (before witnesses) in the absence of the usurper is a legal protest (prevents the claim of undisturbed possession being recognized).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 38b:8">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>היכי דמי מ׳ וכ׳</he> what is a legal protest? If he merely says, This man is a robber, it is not a legal protest.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 39b:7">Ib. 39ᵇ</cite>, sq. <he>מ׳ בפני שנים ואין וכ׳</he> a protest is valid, if made in the presence of two witnesses, nor is it necessary to say, Write; i.e. they may write a document to that effect without being especially authorized; a. fr.
